author: opt-N5

contract.sync_assumed: the whole hardware warp calls the primitive together (all logical warps at once), as the harness does
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one any-vote over the full hardware warp, no barrier
contract.type_constraints: bf16 keys only, two rows of N keys per call packed as bf16x2 words (row 0 in the low half, row 1 in the high half of word j = item j LW + lane), int32 source indices derived from the position, output row r's k indices at out_idx[r K, (r + 1) K). fp32 keys unsupported (two do not fit one register)
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN key is never selected (it loses every max.bf16x2 and min.bf16x2 against a number and both set.gt and set.eq are false), so with fewer than k non-NaN keys output slots stay unwritten. Focus-set inputs carry no NaN. -0.0 equals +0.0: the network orders -0.0 below +0.0, the recovery classifies by IEEE comparison, the selected set is the oracle's set in every case (signed_zero pattern passes under both requirements). Denormals compared as values
contract.tie_break_support: both unsorted requirements with the same code: the tie class at the k-th key fills the remaining slots, in index order whenever it has to be capped (prefer_smaller_index exact by construction), measured identical throughput under both requirements in every cell
contract.sorted_output_support: none: the greater class is written in lane order, then the tie class (lane order on the common path, index order on the capped path). A sorted output would need one shuffle per selected key to move the recovered index to its network position
contract.k_range: [1, N / 2] with MaxK = round_up(k, LW) dividing N, measured k 4, 16, 32, 64
contract.n_range: N = LW x IPT with N / MaxK a power of two, measured N 32 to 256 at LW 32 (two rows of N per call, so 64 to 512 keys per call)

correctness_notes: Oracle battery (13 cases) passed on every cell under both requirements, every row checked on its own. Control W1x_vimnmx_eager in the same lock section. This card is the exact-recovery two-row variant at commit 30f5b8f821 (batch b2, ops_bf16 exchange, ballot-rank tie class in every call), the development step between the first batch (ops_sel, 3ede7791e3, card-less, 445 Gelem per s at N 128 k 32) and the fast-recovery main line N5_rows_f (card N5_rows_f_b200_20261025_1). Both requirements compile the same code and measured identical throughput to 0.1 percent in every cell.

low_level: Throughput kernel at N 128 k 32: 528 SASS instructions for two rows against the control's 336 for one (IMAD 51 against the first batch's 128: the ternary exchange form removed the predicated moves, T53), 82 SHFL, 153 HMNMX2, 8 HSET2, 8 VOTE and 14 POPC for the tie class ballots. Registers 32 at N 32, 40 at N 64, 48 at N 128, 64 at N 256 (occupancy 8, 6, 5, 4 blocks per SM), the select-form kernel of the first batch had 29 to 48 at occupancy 8 to 5.

The exact tie emission per packed word: two VOTE.ANY (one per row), four POPC (rank below the lane and total), two IADD, two ISETP against k and two predicated STS, about 10 instructions more than the scan-only emission of the fast form, 4 to 8 percent of the kernel from N 128 on.
algorithmic: Same-session throughput against the T42 one-word network (b2, both requirements identical): N 32 395 against 270 (1.46x), N 64 407 against 328 to 331 (1.23x to 1.24x), N 128 k 4 to 32 458 against 356 to 358 (1.28x to 1.29x), N 128 k 64 406 against 302 (1.34x), N 256 k 4 to 32 477 against 363 to 367 (1.30x to 1.32x), N 256 k 64 417 against 248 (1.68x). The first batch's select-form exchange measured 358, 418, 445, 405, 457, 409 at the same cells (control 270 to 367).

Latency per call (two rows): 774 against 512 at N 32, 941 against 695 at N 64, 1352 against 1017 at N 128 k 32, 2353 against 1718 at N 256 k 32, 2138 against 1322 at N 256 k 64, that is 0.62x to 0.75x per call and 1.2x to 1.5x per row.

The exact form is the right one where the tie class is large and must be index ordered in every call (quantized or relu logits with many equal keys at rank k), where the fast form's uniform fallback would run every call and cost its branch on top.
negative: Against the fast-recovery form (N5_rows_f, same session) the exact form is 4 to 8 percent slower from N 128 on (458 against 477 at N 128 k 32, 477 against 511 at N 256 k 32, 417 against 452 at N 256 k 64) and equal below.

The select-form exchange of the first batch (three instructions per stage word) cost 3 percent against this card's ternary form at N 128 to 256 and gained 16 registers of occupancy back, which did not matter (T47 pipe bound).
surprises: The ternary exchange form raised the throughput kernel's registers from 32 to 48 at N 128 and from 40 to 64 at N 256 (one fewer blocks per SM each) and still measured faster.
open_questions: Whether the two tie-class ballots per word can be issued back to back for all words (T52 notes the two-class pass does not reach the pipelined-ballot cost), not tried.
